name: filter-scan
description: Tests keys against the BCH Explorer's stored script filters on all cores, for its p2p backend

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix napi-cli --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run check-cargo-version && napi-cli/node_modules/.bin/napi build --platform
scripts.check-cargo-version: VER=$(cat rust-toolchain) ; if ! cargo version | grep "cargo $VER" >/dev/null ; then echo -e "\033[1;35m[[[[WARNING]]]]: cargo version mismatch with ./rust-toolchain version ($VER)!!!\033[0m" >&2; fi
scripts.to-backend: FD=${FILTER_SCAN_FD:-../../backend/rust-filter-scan/} ; rm -rf $FD && mkdir $FD && cp index.js index.d.ts package.json *.node $FD
